decision: fail closed when qualification evidence contains any qrexec service outside the explicitly expected normal and fault services
winner: exact observed-service allowlist over multi-run evidence

reviews.reason: Seeing both expected services is insufficient if an additional service was also invoked; readiness must prove the campaign stayed inside the intended service set.
Unexpected qrexec service use expands the authority surface and could route part of qualification through a differently configured endpoint. Fail closed on any unbound service.
The check reuses already collected service-call evidence, adds no qrexec round trips, has negligible CPU/memory cost, and does not change worker or coordinator runtime semantics.

comparison.approach: require expected normal and fault services to appear, but tolerate extras
comparison.correctness: insufficient: extra service calls can coexist with expected calls
comparison.robustness: low against manifest or routing drift

comparison.correctness: high: every recorded qrexec service must be one of the two deployment-bound services
comparison.robustness: high against accidental or malicious third-service routing in qualification evidence
comparison.regressionRisk: low: qualification-only check, no production worker mutation path changes
comparison.qa: positive expected-service case plus explicit unexpected-service regression test

comparison.robustness: highest if keys are coordinator-only and lifecycle is trusted
comparison.regressionRisk: moderate because response protocol and deployment secrets would change
comparison.qa: would require key lifecycle, response-signature and rotation tests
comparison.result: deferred until real Qubes execution is available

failureFound: The prior multi-run qualification only checked that expected normal and fault services were present. Evidence containing those two plus an unexpected third qrexec service could still pass that service-provenance check.
fix: Add onlyExpectedQrexecServicesObserved and fail readiness whenever any recorded qrexec_service_call is outside expectedService/expectedFaultService.
lessons: Presence checks are not allowlist checks.
Readiness evidence should prove both required coverage and absence of unbound authority paths.
Prefer offline validation when the evidence already contains the necessary signal; it strengthens correctness without increasing worker latency.
safety: Synthetic/defensive qualification only. No real financial transactions, payment data, or weakened security controls.
